_about: OFFICE MEMO v1 strings, signed by narrative design 2026-10-30 (research/narrative/70_terminal_strings.md; mixed case per research/computer_ui/41_c19_period_interaction.md section 6.4, on the C20 face with lowercase). Narrative design owns this file and replaces it whole; nothing is in code. Plain ASCII only: the face draws printable ASCII plus the arrows, box lines, full block and the unread mark (45_c20_face.md), and the unread mark is drawn by code. Program name and memo field labels in capitals; panel titles in Title Case; items, messages and memo bodies in sentence case. The MAIN headline and second line stay in capitals: the block alphabets have capitals, digits and . , : / - ' ! ? only. Memo dates come from the live calendar (1990 weekdays; the newer memo this month, the older four months back; a future date gives month and day only). Tokens: see FrontRoomsTerminalContent.cs.
